answer: By 2030 GSK targets an 80% absolute GHG reduction from 2020 across all scopes and investment in nature-based solutions for the remaining 20%. By 2045 it targets net zero across the full value chain through a 90% absolute reduction from 2020 across all scopes and neutralisation of residual emissions. It separately targets 100% renewably imported and generated electricity by 2030 for Scope 2. The target boundary includes biogenic land-related emissions and removals from bioenergy feedstocks.
